prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a replacement full-body surfing grandmother cutout sprite for an existing vintage paper-collage mobile game. Image 1 is the visual style reference, not a pose or identity to preserve. Create a convincingly elderly 85-year-old petite grandmother inspired by Queen Elizabeth II's familiar elderly appearance and outfits: short carefully curled silver-white hair, lined cheek and smiling profile, soft stooped shoulders, elderly wrinkled hands and slender aged calves. Recognizable pastel lavender small structured hat with tiny flower, pearl earrings and necklace, lavender cardigan over a modest knee-length floral day dress. Bare feet, one ahead of the other, bent knees in a stable surfing stance. Rear three-quarter camera from slightly above and behind, the travel direction is away from camera toward the top of the image. Her face turns just enough to reveal her elderly profile. One hand balances, the other holds a little tropical drink upright. Both bare soles clearly visible at the bottom, rear foot lower/right and front foot slightly higher/left, not a horizontal split stance. Warm vintage photographic paper collage, realistic adult anatomy, fine cream paper cut edge, rich readable lavender color, subtle printed grain like Image 1. Full figure head to toes within portrait canvas with generous transparent padding. Genuinely transparent background. No surfboard (a separate 3D board will support her feet), no water, no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no logo, no crown, no young model physique. Kind, dignified and amusing elderly surfer.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-body surfing hippie with a large modern Bluetooth speaker, a replacement cutout sprite in the same vintage paper-collage game as Image 1. Image 1 is style and rear-view surfing perspective reference. New adult male hippie, around 35: long wavy brown hair past shoulders with a woven headband, visible beard in three-quarter profile, round sunglasses, loose faded tie-dye shirt, olive knee-length shorts, beaded bracelets. Barefoot, knees bent in a stable forward surfing stance viewed from slightly above and behind, traveling away toward top of image. Left arm firmly cradles an unmistakably LARGE modern portable Bluetooth party speaker against hip, about half torso height: rounded long charcoal cylinder / pill-shaped body, woven black mesh fabric grille, solid rubber endcaps, one subtle teal circular light at end, integrated carry strap. Speaker has no cassette deck, radio antenna, knobs, dual exposed retro cones, no logos. Right arm extends naturally to balance. All body and speaker fully inside portrait frame. Clearly visible two bare feet with front foot higher/left and rear foot lower/right, moderately narrow stance. Photographic anatomy and clothing textures, warm slightly faded printing and fine cream paper cutout border matching Image 1. True transparent background, no surfboard, no water, no floor, no shadows outside silhouette, no text. Readable recognizable relaxed hippie silhouette and powerful contemporary speaker, not a retro boombox.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a TWO-COLUMN sprite atlas for a tandem couple in a vintage paper collage surfing game. Image 1 references the two adult characters' appearance, warm photographic print texture and cream paper cut edge. Change their poses and separate them into two independent cutouts in the same image: LEFT HALF: the stocky curly dark-haired adult man with black glasses, yellow tee and navy shorts. RIGHT HALF: the adult long-haired brunette woman in a teal tank top and modest teal surf shorts. Both barefoot, full body, EACH SAME ADULT HEIGHT in its own column with generous transparent space between columns and around edges. Seen from behind and slightly above, rear three-quarter view toward their right, camera about 20 degrees above horizontal. Both travel away toward the top of canvas and lean forward with bent knees in stable surfing positions. Feet fore-aft staggered: front left foot slightly higher and rear right foot slightly lower, modest width to fit a narrow surfboard. Man's right arm reaches forward slightly at waist height to steady his partner in gameplay; left arm balances. Woman's arms spread softly for balance. Exactly two arms and two legs for each person, both pairs of feet fully visible. The two figures DO NOT TOUCH or overlap in this atlas: their cutouts must be separately crop-able. The game will arrange them front and back on one shared 3D surfboard, so NO surfboard, no floor, no water, no environment, no shadows outside the silhouettes. Wide landscape canvas containing two tall cutouts of identical scale aligned along the same foot baseline. Photographic adult anatomy, slightly faded vintage printing, thin cream torn-paper perimeter matching Image 1. Genuinely transparent background, no lettering, logos or panels.

Keep left man and right woman at identical scale and same foot baseline. Make the canvas wider and give a CLEAR EMPTY TRANSPARENT VERTICAL GUTTER AT LEAST 12% OF IMAGE WIDTH between the entire silhouettes (including fingertips).
